The Oscars are this weekend! Have you taken the time to watch all 10 Best Picture nominees? Doubtful, but don't worry! You can keep binging whatever guilty pleasure Netflix is shoveling in your face. Let us be your CliffsNotes, in case you decide to tune in to watch Conan host on Sunday...
